A '''messenger''' was employed by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] in [[4985 BBY]]. That year, he informed prominent [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Seelah Korsin]] and [[Ravilan Wroth]] that the citizens of the town [[Rabolow]] had all mysteriously [[Death/Legends|died]].
